# October 11 fairy and magnifier review

Direction: ART-BIBLE §§3–4 (native pixels, named blood ramp), §6 (attached
four-lobed wings), §9 (attached, accessible Critterpedia), §10 (clear action
contact, falling remains, animated sprays and pools). Compared with the approved
Buttonwood reference, native Worker gallery, and former defeat strip.

Reviewed new poses at native size and in gameplay. The 40×32 Worker anchor and
collision envelope remain intact. Stab retains a bleeding body; Slice separates
the head. Forty-eight particles emit in four timed bursts, settle into irregular
pools and disappear after twelve active-play seconds. Dry ground creates no water;
water contact changes liquid kind while conserving volume. Environmental deaths
still produce ghosts without blood or contamination. Pause freezes effects.

Critterpedia is nonmodal and attached to the magnifier trigger. It opens the
selected entry on click/tap and supports fairy Workers and the moon fairy.
Lens samples cover 90% of the circular glass area. Closest samples win among
subjects, with centered subjects first and terrain treated as backdrop.

Checks: fey-browser, inspector-crew-browser, winter-inspection-browser,
tainted-water. Inspector checks off-center targets at .5×/1×/2×/3× camera zoom,
multiple subjects, moon fairy, click entry, mobile containment, and touch. Sky
checks nearby stars, pinch zoom and pointer exit. Reviewed `defeat-poses.png`,
`blood-pool.png`, `../inspector-crew/critterpedia.png`, and mobile entry screenshots.

Effects are temporary and are not persisted through reloads. No save schema or
ordinary/sample save separation changed.
